title: Fulfillment charge policy satisfaction

decision.boundary: Compose one exact FOOD-005N fulfillment-policy decision with one exact FOOD-005R selected payable-assessment reference. When manual approval is required, exact FOOD-005Q authorized-charge assessment-inclusion evidence for the same order and selected assessment is mandatory. When manual approval is not required, FOOD-005Q evidence is forbidden rather than replaced with synthetic zero-fee approval.
whyNow: FOOD-005R now provides explicit exact payable-assessment selection.
FOOD-005N already supplies the trusted required versus not-required policy outcome.
FOOD-005Q already proves required-path authorized fulfillment-charge inclusion in one exact assessment.
A pure branch-composition record is narrower than checkout/payment readiness and narrower than atomic reservation persistence.

required.assessmentSelection: One exact FOOD-005R selection is required.
required.assessmentInclusion: One exact FOOD-005Q inclusion for the same order and selected payable assessment is required.

notRequired.assessmentSelection: One exact FOOD-005R selection is required.
notRequired.assessmentInclusion: FOOD-005Q inclusion must be absent. No synthetic zero-fee approval or charge evidence may be invented.

output.order: Exact order ID/version shared by FOOD-005N and FOOD-005R.
output.payableAssessment: Exact selected FOOD-005J ID/version from FOOD-005R.

invariants: required policy requires FOOD-005Q inclusion evidence
required FOOD-005Q order must equal FOOD-005R selected order
required FOOD-005Q payable assessment must equal FOOD-005R selected payable assessment
not-required policy forbids FOOD-005Q inclusion evidence
not-required policy does not invent zero-fee approval
not-required policy does not invent FOOD-005O authority
not-required policy does not invent FOOD-005P adjustment
not-required policy does not invent FOOD-005Q inclusion
policy satisfaction does not expose amountDue
policy satisfaction does not choose latest/current assessment
policy satisfaction is detached and immutable
deferred: atomic inventory/slot persistence and race protection
